src: KEIM UK brochure: Fire Resistant Paints and Renders

name: Chanel, New Bond Street
story: Chanel's Mayfair flagship, one of its grandest boutiques, was painted in a bespoke KEIM Granital colour in 2010. KEIM UK features it in its retail brochure.

name: National Trust Northern Ireland head office
story: The National Trust's Northern Ireland head office in Saintfield was redecorated externally in KEIM Soldalit. KEIM UK shows it in its retail brochure.

name: Paul Smith, 9 Albemarle Street
story: The unpainted brickwork of Paul Smith's Albemarle Street shop was given a black matt KEIM finish, chosen for longevity. It appears in KEIM UK's retail brochure.

name: Harrods
story: KEIM UK's retail brochure states that Harrods in Knightsbridge was decorated using KEIM products.

name: 33 Broadwick Street
story: A 1980s Soho office building with polished granite and reconstituted stone was reinvented as design-led workspace. The stone was etched and painted in a blue-black KEIM Royalan.
src: KEIM UK brochure: The Art of Upcycling

name: Greenwood House
story: A tired office building with a matt ceramic-tile facade was refurbished inside and out. KEIM Soldalit painted straight over the tiles to give it a fresh modern look.
src: KEIM UK brochure: The Art of Upcycling

name: Wingfield House
story: A former tax office was converted into 295 student studios. Its unpainted brick and painted concrete were coated in a bright bespoke KEIM Royalan.
src: KEIM UK brochure: The Art of Upcycling

name: Capital House
story: A 13-storey 1970s concrete office tower was converted to student housing. After repairs, KEIM Concretal Lasur was applied by rope access to even out the concrete.
src: KEIM UK brochure: The Art of Upcycling

name: Seymour Mews House
story: A dated 1960s brick and concrete office building was remodelled as modern workspace. Its weathered brickwork was painted black in KEIM Royalan.
src: KEIM UK brochure: The Art of Upcycling

name: 15 Stukeley Street
story: Richard Seifert's 1980s building was renovated and extended into grade A offices while respecting the original design. Its brickwork was painted jet black in KEIM Royalan.
src: KEIM UK brochure: The Art of Upcycling

name: Windsor Road social housing (Tor Homes)
story: Through-coloured render on Tor Homes properties in Dartmouth failed quickly and looked patchy. KEIM used it as a case study for redecorating such render with KEIM Soldalit-ME.
src: KEIM UK brochure: The Smart Alternative to Through-Coloured Render

name: 13-19 Leinster Square
products: KEIM Spachtel, KEIM Soldalit Grob, KEIM Soldalit
story: A Grade II listed Georgian stucco terrace of maisonettes and flats in Bayswater had peeling paint and rust staining. Failing repairs were redone with KEIM Spachtel and the facade finished in white KEIM Soldalit.
src: NBS Source - KEIM Mineral Paints Ltd case study

name: 245 Hammersmith Road
story: The former Bechtel House office was redeveloped as 245 Hammersmith Road. Its hard-to-reach concrete undercroft soffit was painted in KEIM Soldalit and the columns evened out with Concretal Lasur.
src: NBS Source - KEIM Mineral Paints Ltd case study

name: Albion Riverside
story: A riverside apartment and commercial development between Albert and Battersea bridges. In 2003 its concrete V-beams and pool soffits were finished with KEIM Concretal Lasur to keep a natural concrete look.
src: NBS Source - KEIM Mineral Paints Ltd case study

name: Asta House, 80 Charlotte Street
story: Asta House holds 22 apartments in the 80 Charlotte Street development. Its brick and slate building was decorated with KEIM Royalan for a sleek finish.
src: NBS Source - KEIM Mineral Paints Ltd case study

name: 6 College Lawn
products: KEIM Soldalit Fixativ, KEIM Soldalit Grob, KEIM Soldalit-ME
story: Plastic gloss paint had trapped moisture in this Grade II listed Georgian town house. Cement patches and paint were removed, a lime-based shelter coat applied, and the house finished in KEIM Soldalit-ME.
src: NBS Source - KEIM Mineral Paints Ltd case study

name: Deepfields
products: KEIM Universal Render, KEIM Universal Render Fine, KEIM Soldalit
story: This large new house's blockwork walls were rendered in flexible KEIM Universal Render, avoiding visible expansion joints. The render and the humid pool-hall ceilings were finished in KEIM Soldalit.
src: NBS Source - KEIM Mineral Paints Ltd case study

name: Deganwy Quay house
story: A 12-year-old sea-facing house had pink algae on its through-colour render. The seaward side was painted in KEIM Royalan and the copings treated with KEIM Lotexan.
src: NBS Source - KEIM Mineral Paints Ltd case study

name: Headland House
story: A coastal barn conversion in Dale, Pembrokeshire had its old coatings removed and red algae treated. Three coats of KEIM Royalan gave a long-lasting finish.
src: NBS Source - KEIM Mineral Paints Ltd case study

name: Little Grange
products: KEIM Spachtel, KEIM Silan Primer, KEIM Soldalit Fixativ, KEIM Soldalit Grob, KEIM Soldalit-ME, KEIM Concretal-Black
story: A Grade II listed thatched cottage in Dorset had acrylic paint, limewash and bitumen on its lime render. After stripping and repairs it was finished in KEIM Soldalit-ME, with Concretal-Black on the roadside plinth.
src: NBS Source - KEIM Mineral Paints Ltd case study

name: Nationwide Building Society, Merthyr Tydfil
story: The Merthyr Tydfil branch was the third Nationwide site in the region repainted with KEIM in a phased programme. KEIM Soldalit-ME was applied over painted render in colours matched to other branches.
src: NBS Source - KEIM Mineral Paints Ltd case study

name: Riversfield
story: A large Grade B listed town house in Ellon was heavily overgrown with moss and algae. Once cleaned and treated, its roughcast was finished with three coats of KEIM Royalan.
src: NBS Source - KEIM Mineral Paints Ltd case study

name: St Andrew by the Wardrobe
products: KEIM Dolomitspachtel, KEIM IF Primer, KEIM GW Primer, KEIM Optil
story: Wren rebuilt this Grade I listed City church after the Great Fire. In 2023 its cracked, damp-stained interior was repaired and repainted in two soft KEIM Optil shades.
src: NBS Source - KEIM Mineral Paints Ltd case study

name: St Clements Apartments
products: KEIM Restauro Grund, KEIM Universal Render, KEIM Soldalit, KEIM Ecosil-ME
story: A mid-1800s former hospital on Bow Road, damaged by fire and wartime bombs, was converted to homes in 2014. Its render was repaired and painted with KEIM Soldalit, with KEIM Ecosil-ME inside.
src: NBS Source - KEIM Mineral Paints Ltd case study

name: St Winefride's Catholic Church
story: This Grade II listed church had originally been painted with KEIM, which had performed well. After a leak was repaired and mould treated, it was repainted in KEIM Optil.
src: NBS Source - KEIM Mineral Paints Ltd case study

name: The Caledonian
products: KEIM Restauro Grund, KEIM Restauro Top, KEIM Soldalit
story: This category A listed 19th-century pub had up to ten layers of paint on its sandstone. Deep repairs used KEIM Restauro mortars and the facade was finished in matching KEIM Soldalit.
src: NBS Source - KEIM Mineral Paints Ltd case study

name: The Colonnade
products: KEIM Algicid, KEIM Silan 100, KEIM IF Primer, KEIM Soldalit Grob, KEIM Soldalit
story: This Grade II listed seafront colonnade, built for George V's coronation, suffered from water ingress in an exposed spot. Rother District Council had it repaired and finished in breathable KEIM Soldalit.
src: NBS Source - KEIM Mineral Paints Ltd case study

name: The Leaning Woman statue
products: KEIM Algicid, KEIM Silan Primer, KEIM Granital
story: Karel Vogel's Grade II listed 1938 concrete statue by the Great West Road had cracked and rusted. It was repaired and finished in KEIM Granital, unveiled by the Duke of Gloucester in 2024 and given a Hammersmith Society award.
src: NBS Source - KEIM Mineral Paints Ltd case study

name: Waitrose, South Street
products: KEIM Uniputz 1.3, KEIM Soldalit Grob, KEIM Soldalit
story: Waitrose's 1961 Dorking store had delaminating render and algae staining. After patch repairs in KEIM Uniputz, the elevation was finished in two coats of white KEIM Soldalit.
src: NBS Source - KEIM Mineral Paints Ltd case study

name: Walton Windmill
story: This Grade II listed windmill on Walton Hill, owned by the Clarks shoe family, was first painted in KEIM Soldalit in 2010. After 14 years it only needed cleaning before a fresh coat of KEIM Soldalit-ME.
src: NBS Source - KEIM Mineral Paints Ltd case study

name: 22 West Tollcross car park
story: New concrete columns in the basement car park at 22 West Tollcross showed salt efflorescence. They were treated with KEIM Silan Primer and coated in anti-carbonation KEIM Concretal-C.

name: 24 Kensington Park Gardens
products: KEIM Soldalit Fixativ, KEIM Soldalit Grob, KEIM Soldalit-ME
story: Acrylic paint had cracked the lime stucco of this large Grade II* listed house. After repairs, it was repainted in two coats of a bespoke photocatalytic KEIM Soldalit-ME.

name: Belsfield Hotel
story: This large lakeside hotel built in 1845 was redecorated in KEIM Soldalit-ME. The breathable paint protects the old fabric and resists mould.

name: Blaenffos Baptist Chapel
products: KEIM Soldalit Fixativ, KEIM Soldalit Grob, KEIM Soldalit
story: This Grade II listed 1785 chapel in north Pembrokeshire was repaired ahead of hosting an Eisteddfod. Its lime render was primed, evened out and painted in two KEIM Soldalit colours.

name: Bore Place
story: Newly skimmed interior walls and ceilings at Bore Place in Kent were painted in KEIM Optil for a breathable, colourfast finish.

name: Empire Cinema
story: Anglesey's only cinema was fully restored for Holyhead Town Council. It was painted in a vibrant KEIM Soldalit that will not fade.

name: Fairlight cottage porch
story: Muralist Michael Madden painted a later porch on a 17th-century cottage near Hastings to blend with the old building, including painted lichens. He used KEIM Soldalit so the effect will not fade.

name: Greater London House
story: The smooth render of this Art Deco former cigarette factory was painted in KEIM Granital. The colour was precisely matched to the original facade.

name: Hawthorn Cottage
products: KEIM Soldalit Grob, KEIM Soldalit-ME, KEIM Design Lasur
story: The painted and bare render of this cottage near Colchester was given a KEIM Soldalit-ME base. KEIM Design Lasur on top created a limewash look.

name: The Judge's Lodging
products: KEIM Restauro Grund, KEIM Restauro Top, KEIM Soldalit, KEIM Algicid
story: This award-winning Victorian judge's lodging museum had been painted in KEIM Granital about 20 years earlier. In 2018 acrylic was removed, soft stone repaired with Restauro mortars and the building repainted in KEIM Soldalit.

name: Knocktarna, Ulster University
story: This Ulster University property in Coleraine had its render and sandstone grit-blasted and repaired. The KEIM Soldalit system with a Grob undercoat hid the repairs.

name: Melin Maelgwyn windmill
story: A Grade II listed windmill on Anglesey was re-rendered in flexible KEIM Universal Render. It was then painted with KEIM Royalan for long-term protection.

name: Portaferry Market House
story: Portaferry's Grade B listed 1752 market house, now a community hall, had new lime roughcast. It was finished with three coats of KEIM Royalan.

name: St Mary's Church, Ladykirk
story: James IV built this all-stone category A listed church by the Tweed around 1500. After sandstone repairs it was treated with clear KEIM Lotexan N to repel water without changing its look.

name: St Michael & All Angels Church
products: KEIM Universal Render, KEIM Concretal Lasur
story: The old render of this Cheshire church was replaced with KEIM Universal Render. It was then given a natural colourwash finish in KEIM Concretal Lasur.

name: St Vincent de Paul Church
story: This Grade II listed 1850s church had failing coatings and salt-damaged plaster. After repairs in lime plaster, the interior was painted with two coats of KEIM Optil.

name: The Esplanade house
products: KEIM STS 7M, KEIM Algicid, KEIM Spachtel, KEIM Royalan
story: Old paint was stripped from this seafront house with KEIM STS 7M and the algae treated. Render cracks were filled and three coats of KEIM Royalan applied.

name: The White House, Odiham
products: KEIM Soldalit Fixativ, KEIM Soldalit Grob, KEIM Soldalit-ME
story: This Grade II listed house was re-rendered in NHL lime and lime putty. After curing it was finished in white KEIM Soldalit-ME for resistance to dirt and algae.

name: Tun Abdul Razak Research Centre (Brickendonbury)
products: KEIM Fine Finishing Mortar, KEIM Granital
story: The research centre occupies a Jacobean mansion in Hertfordshire. Surface repairs were made with KEIM Fine Finishing Mortar before the exterior was painted in KEIM Granital.

name: Smeaton's Tower
story: The red-and-white upper part of John Smeaton's 1759 Eddystone lighthouse, rebuilt on Plymouth Hoe, appears in stockist Celtic Sustainables' KEIM Royalan project gallery.

name: Beachfront home, Llangrannog
story: A rendered home right on the Ceredigion coast needed protection from salt air and storms. Celtic Sustainables recommended KEIM Soldalit, and the freshly repaired facade was finished in bright white.

name: Dublin Castle
story: Irish KEIM stockist McConnells Coatings names Dublin Castle among the buildings where KEIM paints are found. No project details are given.

name: Áras an Uachtaráin
story: McConnells Coatings, an Irish KEIM stockist, lists the Irish President's residence in Phoenix Park among buildings where KEIM paints are found. No project details are given.

name: 1399 Park Avenue
products: KEIM Heavy Duty Cleaner, Concretal-Lasur, Concretal Fixative
story: A 22-storey East Harlem apartment tower beside the Park Avenue railroad viaduct, composed of interlocking concrete volumes. Blotchy, unevenly coloured formed concrete was cleaned and then evened out with Concretal-Lasur, keeping the natural patina of the cast surface.

name: 1800 & 2000 Perimeter Park Drive
colours: SW Snowbound (white) and SW Iron Ore (black)
story: Two identical 20th-century office buildings were refreshed to lift curb appeal and occupancy. The owners chose a crisp black-and-white scheme in Restauro stain, and the makeover was credited with a marked improvement in leasing.

name: 23XI Racing 'Airspeed' Headquarters
story: The 114,000 sq ft race-shop headquarters of the NASCAR team co-owned by Michael Jordan and Denny Hamlin. The design team wanted the 'blackest black' with a colour warranty; KEIM won a competitive mock-up on a tilt-up panel against three other suppliers.

name: 55 Third Avenue
story: A 4,000 sq ft mixed-use addition to an existing Manhattan high-rise needed seamless smooth walls up to 80 feet long with no visible joints. A lime-rich Universalputz stucco over Durock sheathing was finished with Soldalit for a dead-flat mineral matte look.

name: Arkansas State Capitol
story: A phased restoration of the white capitol, which suffered from soiling, biological growth and water ingress at the dome. The dome got two coats of Royalan, the pediments and areas above the cornices were treated with Restauro-Lasur, and the Arkansas limestone below received a protective Restauro dilution.

name: Arlington House (Custis-Lee Mansion)
products: KEIM Universalputz, Royalan, Silan 100, Contact Plus
story: The 1802-1818 Greek Revival mansion in Arlington National Cemetery, now a National Park Service memorial. After mock-ups and NPS approval the stucco was stripped, repaired and skimmed with Universalputz, and the historic faux ashlar finishes on the facades and columns were recreated with KEIM mineral coatings.

name: Brooklyn Navy Yard Building 77
story: A 1942 windowless naval storage and intelligence building, now a National Register-listed hub for urban manufacturing with a food hall. Heavily patched historic concrete was toned with Concretal-Lasur to blend repairs while keeping its gritty raw character.

name: Central Square Library Garage Mural ('Wonder')
story: A faded mural on the concrete garage beside the Central Square branch library was replaced with a new work by Silvia Lopez Chavez celebrating libraries, with birds, paper planes and open books. It was painted with Concretal-W and Concretal-Lasur for colour that lasts on exposed concrete.

name: Charleston County Courthouse
products: KEIM Soldalit, Contact Plus Grob (KEIM Grob)
story: The courthouse at Charleston's 'Four Corners of Law' dates from 1753 and was rebuilt in 1792. Cracks in the stucco were bridged with KEIM Grob, then the courthouse and the Blake Tenement behind it were coated in custom-matched Soldalit, with adhesion tests throughout.
consultant: SKA Consulting Engineers (engineer); Meadors, Inc. (preservation consultant)

name: Courtyard by Marriott Dupont Circle
story: A highly visible concrete hotel on a major Washington thoroughfare whose owners wanted a finish that would look good for decades. After concrete repairs and a Concretal Fine Filler levelling coat, the building was painted in the Soldalit system.

name: Fair-Haired Dumbbell
story: Two angled six-storey office towers at the Burnside Bridgehead, linked by sky bridges and wrapped on every side in artwork by James Jean. The hand-painted exterior was executed in Soldalit.

name: George Washington Elementary School
story: Precast exposed-aggregate panels more than 20 years old were streaked with iron-oxide staining. They were restored with Concretal-W and then protected with a PSS 20 anti-graffiti coat.

name: Georgia Street Bridge
story: Seismic retrofit and rehabilitation of the 1914 bridge and retaining walls over University Avenue, keeping their historic character while improving pedestrian and bike access. The concrete was finished in Concretal-W for breathable, long-lasting colour.

name: Herald Examiner Building
story: The former newspaper headquarters on Broadway, a Los Angeles Historic-Cultural Monument since 1977. It was renovated as the LA home of Arizona State University's Cronkite School of Journalism, with Soldalit and Soldalit Grob on the exterior.

name: Juliette Gordon Low Birthplace
story: The 1821 birthplace of the Girl Scouts' founder, Savannah's first National Historic Landmark. Hard cement stucco that was damaging the soft brick was removed and replaced with mesh-reinforced Universalputz lime stucco, finished in two coats of Soldalit, with PSS 20 anti-graffiti on the west wall, aiming for a 100-year solution.

name: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse
story: An 1860 brick lighthouse first painted red with KEIM mineral paint in 1905 and again in the 1960s. After Hurricane Jeanne stripped the upper tower in 2004 it was touched up in Soldalit, and in 2019 the whole tower was repainted with Soldalit.
iby: Clinton & Charles Robertson from Del Rio, Texas & College Station, TX, USA

name: King William Charles Lunalilo's Tomb
story: The royal mausoleum of Hawaii's first elected king, in the grounds of Kawaiaha'o Church. After restoration the precast stone was given two coats of Royalan colour-matched to the original, and photos 3.5 years later show it still kept clean by rainfall alone.

name: Legacy Central
story: An 85-acre former Texas Instruments production campus turned into a mixed-use office, retail and residential district. Soldalit modernised the dated off-white brick and Concretal Pro was used on the new parking garages.

name: Lloyd Street Synagogue
story: Built in 1845 to designs by Robert Cary Long Jr., it is Maryland's first synagogue and the third-oldest standing synagogue building in the US. Its Greek Revival exterior was coated in Concretal-W for durable weather protection.

name: Freedom Tower
products: KEIM Universalputz Standard, KEIM Glass Fiber Mesh
story: The 1925 Mediterranean Revival newspaper tower that later processed Cuban refugees and is now a Miami Dade College cultural centre. Its cracked, detaching stucco was replaced with mesh-reinforced Universalputz render to keep the building dry in Miami's humid climate.

name: Moody Amphitheater, Waterloo Greenway
story: The open-air theatre at the heart of the Waterloo Greenway, a steel lattice canopy over curving raw concrete. When the cast concrete came out patchy, a mineral stain strategy using Concretal-Lasur subtly camouflaged the mismatches while keeping its earthy, raw look.

name: National Holocaust Monument
story: Canada's national Holocaust memorial, six triangular cast-in-place concrete volumes arranged as the points of a star, including the 14-metre Sky Void. The exposed concrete was finished with Concretal-Lasur mineral stain.

name: National Veterans Memorial and Museum
products: KEIM Heavy Duty Cleaner, Concretal-Lasur, Concretal Fixative
story: A riverfront museum and memorial honouring veterans from every conflict, where building and landscape merge in a single sweeping concrete form. The concrete was cleaned and stained with Concretal-Lasur for a more even tone that keeps the natural patina.

name: Pier 53 Fireboat House (Marine Company 1)
story: A historic Hudson River fireboat station in Manhattan. New concrete base and curb walls were cleaned, treated with Silan 100 and coated in custom-matched Concretal-W Grob and Concretal-W to cope with constant water and weather exposure.

name: Peter Pan Office Flex Building
products: KEIM Concretal PRO Sand Finish Base Coat, Concretal PRO, Concretal Fixative
story: A new 60,000 sq ft concrete tilt-up flex building whose developer had seen acrylic elastomerics fade within years. A multi-colour earth-tone scheme in Concretal PRO, over a sand-finish base coat, gave a lightfast finish that evens out panel texture.

name: Porchlight Men's Shelter Mural
story: A 3,000 sq ft mural by Guido van Helten wraps the new men's shelter as part of an 'art melts walls' concept. It was meant to connect housed and unhoused neighbours and make the building read more like a museum than a shelter.

name: SCAD FORTY Residence Hall
story: A 14-storey student residence on SCAD's Atlanta campus built from custom precast concrete. The building was finished in the school's signature grey with Concretal-W for a fade-resistant, low-maintenance coating.

name: SCAD River Residence Hall
story: A new suite-style student residence near downtown Savannah with a dining hall and market on the ground floor. The contractor selected Concretal-W in a deep grey for the exterior concrete to stand up to the harsh coastal climate.

name: Silos at the Mill Mural
products: KEIM Concretal-Lasur, Concretal Fixative, Concretal Black
story: Guido van Helten wrapped the H.D. Lee Flour Mill grain elevator with local children playing 'Ring Around the Rosie'. Translucent Concretal-Lasur kept the character of the aged concrete, with Concretal Black for the negative space.

name: St. Benedict Classical Academy
story: A new K-6 Catholic school building with a temple-front pediment and homely New England detailing. KEIM mineral paint was specified over poly-ash cementitious siding, its bright white bouncing daylight deep into the building from the courtyard.

name: University at Albany Dormitory Towers
colours: Two custom colours for cast concrete and precast fins
architect: WJE New York; Bell and Spina Architects
builder: G L Capasso, Inc.; Debrino Caulking Associates, Inc.
story: The 24-storey residence towers of Edward Durell Stone's uptown SUNY Albany campus had weathered badly. After concrete repairs they were treated with Silan 100 and two coats of Concretal-Lasur in two colours, restoring an even look while repelling water.

name: The Ark House
story: A small studio and guest building on the site of Richard Neutra's 1934 Sten-Frenke House, its curved facade echoing the sunroom of the main house. It is finished in luminous white Concretal-W.

name: The Morrison House
story: An 1857 mansion of 9,700 sq ft restored over two years after decades of neglect. The faded, soiled stucco was washed and given two coats of colour-matched KEIM silicate paint in a hue more fitting to its period.

name: United States Capitol (West Front)
products: KEIM Bio Paint Stripper Heavy Duty, Soldalit, Granital
architect: Architect of the Capitol (Mary Oehrlein); Hartman Cox Architects (consultant)
story: Long-term preservation of the Capitol's stone West Front, including cleaning, biological growth removal and stone and mortar repair. Old coatings were stripped and the facade received three coats of KEIM mineral coatings, chosen for vapour permeability and durability.

name: West Point Lighthouse
products: KEIM Universalputz Standard, Glass Fiber Mesh, Silan 100, Soldalit ME, Soldalit
story: An active 1881 brick-and-stucco light station in Discovery Park battered by salt air and trapped moisture. It was restored to the Secretary of the Interior's Standards: Universalputz render with glass mesh, Silan 100, Soldalit ME on the white areas and Soldalit on the green.

name: Williams Terrace Senior Housing
architect: McMillan Pazdan Smith Architecture; David Baker Architects (design)
story: Forty-one affordable, flood-resilient senior apartments on a site wrecked by Hurricane Hugo, arranged around a courtyard with Charleston-style piazzas. To satisfy the Board of Architectural Review, the brick was given a whitewash look with diluted Restauro-Lasur in warm white.

name: Catfiddle Street
colours: Romanit R-20, R-40, R-70; Exclusiv 9255 and 9354
architect: Andrew Gould, New World Byzantine (and other designers)
story: A new-traditional infill street on the elevated site of an 1812-era earthen fort in Charleston's historic district, mixing restored 1890s houses with new masonry homes. Romanit lime paint gave the new houses strong, non-fading colour that weathers like old Charleston.

name: Holy Ascension Orthodox Church
story: A Byzantine-style Orthodox church in the I'On neighbourhood, consecrated in 2008. KEIM materials were used inside and out: the church was plastered with KEIM lime-based plaster, and its dome iconography was later painted in silicate paint.
src: KEIM USA Blog; Orthodox Arts Journal
artist: Dmitri Shkolnik, Aleko Mchedlishvili, Vladimir Grygorenko

name: Canvas Tower Mural (Pearlie Harris)
products: KEIM Soldalit, KEIM mineral stains and dilution
story: A photo-realistic mural of retired educator Pearlie Harris with present-day students, marking 50 years since Greenville's schools desegregated. The brick had an old water-repellent treatment, so Soldalit was used as an adhesive base before the image was finished in stains.

name: Ponce de Leon Inlet Lighthouse
story: Florida's tallest lighthouse had its brick tower repainted in three applications of venetian red KEIM mineral coating. KEIM donated paint for the third coat, and HIS Painting of Titusville did the work.
src: Ponce de Leon Inlet Lighthouse Preservation Association (Illuminations newsletter)

name: Cape Hatteras Lighthouse
builder: Stone & Lime Masonry Restoration Services (with National Park Service)
story: America's tallest brick lighthouse is in a multi-year National Park Service restoration that began in 2024. A KEIM test stripe has been applied, and the black-and-white spiral is to be recreated with two coats of KEIM mineral paint. The work was still in progress in 2026.

name: National Zoo General Services Building Retaining Wall
products: KEIM mineral paint (five colours), Concretal dilution, KEIM Lasur
story: A 43-foot-tall, 900-foot-long cast concrete retaining wall at the Smithsonian National Zoo was given a faux-stone finish matching rock from nearby Rock Creek Park. EverGreene used five KEIM mineral paint colours with glazing and stippling, sealed with Concretal dilution and Lasur.

name: Minneapolis City Hall (Municipal Building)
story: The Romanesque Revival municipal building, which also houses the Hennepin County courthouse. Repairs were given a custom KEIM coating to match the pattern and look of the existing granite.

name: South Hall, UC Berkeley
story: The oldest building on the University of California's Berkeley campus, completed in 1873. In the restoration, natural speckling was added to repairs with KEIM Design-Lasur to match the original masonry.

name: Pacific Building
colours: Shades of green with white highlights
story: An early reinforced-concrete office block on Market Street, known for its green-glazed cladding. Custom KEIM coatings recreated the varied greens and white highlights of the cladding on repairs.

name: Hunter-Dulin Building
story: A 1920s Romanesque/French château-style office tower in the Financial District. KEIM silicate coatings were custom-matched to its terracotta and glazed brick for the restoration.

name: Museum of Science and Industry
story: The former Palace of Fine Arts from the 1893 World's Columbian Exposition, now one of the largest science museums in the Americas. A custom-blended KEIM coating with mica inclusions was used to match the original terracotta.

name: Gage Building
story: A Michigan Avenue loft building whose facade was designed by Louis Sullivan. A custom-blended KEIM coating with mica inclusions was used to match the original terracotta during restoration.

name: Dallas Fair Park Bourdelle Murals
sub: Six lost 1936 murals recreated in situ with Keim mineral coating
story: EverGreene was chosen in 2004 to recreate six lost murals originally designed by Pierre Bourdelle in 1936, each about 15 ft wide by 27 ft high. The murals were executed in situ using Keim mineral coating paint on newly prepared walls.

name: Wilshire Boulevard Temple
sub: Restored 100 ft dome and sanctuary ceilings finished with Keim paint and glazes
story: The Temple of the Stars underwent restoration and seismic stabilization from 2011. EverGreene restored the plaster and painted finishes in the dome, executed with Keim paint, glazes and composite leaf gilding.

name: Grand Central Air Terminal
sub: 1928 Spanish Revival airport terminal restored and coated with Keim
architect: Frederick Fisher and Partners Architects (restoration); Henry L. Gogerty (original, 1928)
story: EverGreene restored the interior and exterior of the 1928 terminal, including decorative plaster, tilework and cast stone. A stable, protective Keim coating was applied throughout the building.

name: National Cowgirl Museum and Hall of Fame Mural
sub: Richard Haas mural of five galloping cowgirls painted with Keim paints
story: In 2002 EverGreene worked with Richard Haas to execute his full-scale mural, painted directly on the wall with Keim Paints, about 23 ft high by 42 ft wide.

name: Downtown Doral Charter Elementary School Murals
sub: Two Richard Haas murals painted with Keim mineral paints
story: Two Richard Haas murals on the school portico facade and a freestanding wall were executed by EverGreene in fall 2015, painted directly on the walls with Keim mineral paints.

name: Homage to the Chicago School (1211 N LaSalle)
sub: Haas trompe l'oeil mural on three sides of an 18-floor apartment house
story: Painted on three sides of an 18-floor apartment house, mimicking the finished front facade as an homage to Louis Sullivan. EverGreene executed Haas's color maquettes full scale; the source states the Haas murals were painted directly on the surface with Keim mineral paints.

name: Homewood Murals
sub: Fifteen Richard Haas murals scattered around the town
story: Fifteen murals around the town depict community, architecture, transportation and family. EverGreene executed Haas's color maquettes full scale; the source states the Haas murals were painted directly on the surface with Keim mineral paints.

name: Bradley Symphony Center Mural
sub: Haas faux-window mural reflecting lost Wisconsin Avenue buildings
story: A series of windows and a large central faux glass panel reflects buildings along Wisconsin Avenue, including the former Pabst Building, Lake Front Depot and Gimbels. EverGreene executed Haas's color maquettes full scale; the source states the Haas murals were painted directly on the surface with Keim mineral paints.

name: Homage to Cincinnatus (Brotherhood Building)
sub: Haas mural of the marble statue of Cincinnatus
story: The mural depicts a central marble statue of Lucius Quinctius Cincinnatus, the Roman statesman for whom the city is named. EverGreene executed Haas's color maquettes full scale; the source states the Haas murals were painted directly on the surface with Keim mineral paints.

name: 2300 Chestnut Street Mural
sub: Office building turned into a trompe l'oeil labyrinth of arches with William Penn
story: An office building was transformed into a labyrinth of arched openings containing a figure of William Penn, painted from Thomas Eakins's Max Schmitt in a Single Scull. EverGreene executed Haas's color maquettes full scale; the source states the Haas murals were painted directly on the surface with Keim mineral paints.

name: Edison Brothers Stores Mural
sub: Three-sided Haas mural with eight obelisks and painted sculpture
story: A three-sided mural with eight obelisks at its corners, a painted sculpture of Peace on the west facade and an equestrian statue of St Louis on the south facade. EverGreene executed Haas's color maquettes full scale; the source states the Haas murals were painted directly on the surface with Keim mineral paints.

name: Lincoln Building Mural
sub: Haas mural of young Abraham Lincoln opposite Ford's Theatre
story: Painted on the building adjacent to the house where Lincoln died and opposite Ford's Theatre, the mural depicts Lincoln as a young man. EverGreene executed Haas's color maquettes full scale; the source states the Haas murals were painted directly on the surface with Keim mineral paints.

name: Gateway to the Waterfront
sub: Three Haas murals on downtown Yonkers buildings
story: Painted as part of downtown improvements, three murals depict Yonkers history including indigenous peoples, Dutch settlers, an 18th century English village and 19th century industry. EverGreene executed Haas's color maquettes full scale; the source states the Haas murals were painted directly on the surface with Keim mineral paints.

name: Fulton Theatre Mural
sub: Haas mural of a stage showing Pittsburgh's steel legacy
story: The mural represents a stage on which Pittsburgh's steel legacy is depicted, including a steel mill interior with furnaces pouring hot metal. EverGreene executed Haas's color maquettes full scale; the source states the Haas murals were painted directly on the surface with Keim mineral paints.

name: The Dwelling Place Mural (Heartside)
sub: Haas mural for Heartside neighborhood redevelopment
story: Painted as part of the Heartside Neighborhood Redevelopment project of The Dwelling Place, an affordable housing and neighborhood revitalization organisation. EverGreene executed Haas's color maquettes full scale; the source states the Haas murals were painted directly on the surface with Keim mineral paints.

name: Bank One Ballpark Interior Murals
sub: Haas murals of sports history and Arizona topography
story: Interior murals depict sports throughout history, including the Arizona Diamondbacks, and the topography of Arizona. EverGreene executed Haas's color maquettes full scale; the source states the Haas murals were painted directly on the surface with Keim mineral paints.

name: Pergola of Justice, Sarasota County Courthouse
sub: Haas trompe l'oeil arcades and pergolas framing an image of Justice
story: A series of three-dimensional arcades and pergolas frame an image of Justice and are adorned with garden foliage. EverGreene executed Haas's color maquettes full scale; the source states the Haas murals were painted directly on the surface with Keim mineral paints.
powner: Sarasota County Clerk of the Circuit Court

name: Blake Tenement Building (behind Charleston County Courthouse)
sub: Stucco portions painted with Keim Soldalit during the courthouse restoration
story: The Blake Tenement building behind the courthouse also received Keim Soldalit, applied to the stucco portions of its lower section and right-hand side.
iby: Historic American Buildings Survey (Library of Congress)

name: Harbor Freeway Olympic Mural (Terry Schoonhoven)
sub: 1984 Olympics freeway mural of Roman ruins above a mirrored LA skyline
story: Working above the Harbor Freeway and using Keim mineral paint, Schoonhoven painted Roman ruins and Greek sculpture in the foreground of a mirror image of the downtown Los Angeles skyline for the 1984 Olympics freeway murals.

name: Kilkeel Credit Union
sub: Category B1 listed former bank, Granital
story: Early 20th-century neo-classical former bank, first painted with KEIM Granital in 2011 and redecorated in Granital in 2021 for a new colour.

name: English Language Centre Brighton & Hove
sub: Grade II listed language school, Soldalit Grob and Royalan
story: KEIM Soldalit Grob base coat then KEIM Royalan (magnolia) over previously painted smooth render, chosen for the exposed coastal site.

name: Southampton Hotel, Jersey
sub: Retained pub facade, Royalan
story: Public house rebuilt behind its retained facade (offices above a new bar); KEIM Royalan protects the exposed facades. Specifier: Camerons Ltd.

name: The Lodge, Wadhurst
sub: Granital over Universal Render on pebbledash
story: KEIM Universal Render and Granital applied over existing pebbledash render.

name: Radiant House, Mortimer Street
sub: Restauro Lasur to blend tile repairs, Fitzrovia
story: Repairs to a turquoise-tiled building were blended with the surrounding beige facade using KEIM Restauro Lasur.

name: KOKO Camden
sub: Grade II listed theatre exterior after fire, Soldalit
story: Fire-damaged exterior of the Grade II listed former Camden Theatre recoated in KEIM Soldalit (Grecian White and Exclusiv 9157) for reopening, specified via Promain for contractor Oakdene Finishes.

name: Royal Sussex County Hospital (Barry Building)
sub: Exterior refurbishment, Royalan
story: Barry Building (1828) and Jubilee Building were painted for the first time with KEIM Royalan on facades and concrete staircases, with a 20-year warranty.

name: Bishops Avenue, Elswick (Colourful Newcastle)
sub: Street of many colours, regeneration
story: Every house in Bishops Avenue was painted a different colour with KEIM Mineral Paints in Newcastle City Council's west-end housing regeneration.

name: Scottish Parliament Building
sub: Granital, Concretal Lasur, Lotexan and Ecotec on concrete
story: KEIM Granital painted about 5,000 m2 of fair-faced concrete and block walls; Concretal Lasur unified concrete tone, with Lotexan and Ecotec also used, plus Queensberry House.

name: 25 Berkeley Square
sub: Restauro Lasur on Portland stone
story: 1906 office building by Frank Verity; KEIM Restauro Lasur applied to Portland stone to blend imperfections while keeping its natural look.

name: Marmalade Lane
sub: Co-housing, Soldalit on new brickwork
story: 42-home co-housing community (RIBA East and National Awards 2019) with KEIM Soldalit on new brickwork facades.

name: Chestnut Hill, Malvern Wells
sub: New-build homes, Universal Render and Soldalit
story: Owners chose KEIM Universal Render finished with KEIM Soldalit on new blockwork properties.

name: Tay Street Lane Mural
sub: Gable-end mural, Soldalit
story: Gable-end mural facilitated by Open/Close Dundee, painted in KEIM Soldalit.

sub: Former department store converted, Soldalit system
products: KEIM Soldalit Fixativ, KEIM Soldalit Grob, KEIM Soldalit
story: 1895 Victorian lime render and stone former Brays store converted to apartments, redecorated with the KEIM Soldalit system.

sub: Optil and Royalan on concrete
story: Car park built under the Manchester Airport Transformation Programme from 2017; KEIM Optil on sheltered levels and Royalan on exposed Level 8.

name: Stone Bay Court
sub: Seafront apartments, Royalan
products: KEIM Royalan, KEIM Universal Render Fine
story: Through-coloured render first decorated in KEIM in 2014 and redecorated with Royalan in late 2020 after crack repairs.

story: UK's first joint-use university and public library; KEIM Concretal Lasur colourwash finished internal concrete.

story: Stephen Pusey's 30 x 104 ft mural, funded by Lambeth Council, is recorded as painted in Keim silicate paints.
